fact: An April 2022 report for the Ministry of Posts and Telecommunications states that no legislation has been adopted to regulate addressing in Cameroon, that most of the population has no physical address, and proposes a national digital addressing system.
title: Etude en vue de la mise en place d'un système national d'adressage numérique au Cameroun : rapport provisoire des travaux
publisher: Ministère des Postes et Télécommunications / Geomatic Services and Equipment (GSE)
